description:
Write a support-ready Markdown report: doctor checks, engine health, diagnostics, console and debugger output, and a hand-off prompt. No tokens or file contents; the person should still read it before sending it.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/create-debug-report"}

include_doctor.description: Include summer doctor checks in the report.

include_play_session.description: Launch the game briefly and collect post-play diagnostics.

max_console_lines.description: Console lines to include after filtering/deduping.

max_debugger_entries.description: Debugger error/warning entries to include after filtering/deduping.

output_path.description: Where to write the Markdown report. Defaults to the open project root, or the current working directory if no project is open.

play_wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after launching the game when include_play_session is true.

name: summer_create_debug_report
title: Write a debug report
